full_judgment:
K. M. Subhan, J.:- This appeal by special leave is against the judgment and decree passed by a Single Judge of the High Court Division in Second Appeal No. 346 of 1975 which arose from the judgment and decree passed by' the Additional District Judge, Tangail in Other Class Appeal No. 30 of 1974, affirming the judgment and decree dated 30th August, 1974 passed .by the Second Court of Munsif Tangail in Title Suit No. 37 of 1972. 

 6. On appeal, the learned Additional District Judge, affirmed the judgment and decree passed by the trial Court with the same findings. On second appeal to the High Court, the learned Single Judge decreed the suit holding that the courts committed an error in deciding the suit on the proposition of law that the sale being held deterring the period of attachment was Pd the learned Single Judge held that the sale during the subsistence of the order of attachment was not wholly void, but void against the person, in whose favors the attachment is made and it was subject to the decision of the suit in which the order of attachment was passed. 

 The appeal is, therefore, allowed without any order as to costs and judgment and decree under appeal are set aside; and the case is remanded back to the lower appellate Court for disposal in accordance with law.
